name: realx8-core
description: Realx8 backend — nine services, one deployable, splittable per service.

scripts.dev: nodemon --watch server.js --watch platform --watch shared --watch services --ext js server.js
scripts.dev:split: concurrently -n gateway,auth,user,property,investment,crm,finance,notification,support "npm run dev --workspace services/api-gateway" "npm run dev --workspace services/auth-service" "npm run dev --workspace services/user-service" "npm run dev --workspace services/property-service" "npm run dev --workspace services/investment-service" "npm run dev --workspace services/crm-service" "npm run dev --workspace services/finance-service" "npm run dev --workspace services/notification-service" "npm run dev --workspace services/support-service"
